decisions.result: Reuse returned anonymous token, serialize SPA visits, normalize pathname, exclude hash/query changes and automated browsers; isolated service and fixture browser tests passed

Shanghai date captured at the browse event; recently completed three days re-read; complete means day-end read, never a provider seal; activation records first successful Pages confirmation with source SHA/run URL
Validate numeric data and archive provenance, keep trusted data on failure/regression; no retry of timed-out POST; no-referrer and date-only key; no personal logs in public history
Only PV is cumulative; daily UV stays daily; today replaces its JSON row; gaps stay unknown and break curves; start day marked partial; content updates exclude archive commits

limitations: Public third-party counter availability is not guaranteed
UV is an anonymous estimate, not authenticated natural people
Scheduled archive times may be delayed; no invented historical counts
